# Task Deck
中文 · English
**Task Deck is a personal mission control for DSH Desktop.** It reads the live DSH session catalog,
turns every conversation into a task-shaped card, and keeps your attention on the next useful move.
Built for people who run many conversations and branches at once: see what is running, what is waiti
ng on you, what is blocked, and what is ready for review — then continue, fork, or hand off without
is blocked, and what is ready for review — then continue, fork, or hand off without losing context.
## Features

- **Sidebar entry** — Task Deck in `sidebar.panellist`, with a badge for Blocked + Review.
- **Live

Dashboard** — real DSH conversations grouped by state, with search and status filters.
- **Task Deta
il** — real session title / ID / workspace, running state, fork lineage, an editable personal Next A

ction, personal checklist, related conversations, review gate.
- **Task Thread** — a right-sidebar t

ab and conversation-header launcher bound to the current `sessionId`.
- **Continue / Fork / Handoff*
* — open the current conversation, create a real child session with `sessions.fork()`, or fork-and-m

ark-waiting for a parallel workflow.
- **Personal annotation layer** — status overrides, Next Action

, checks, priority, branch label, and alias are yours; they never rewrite the conversation.
- **Idle
auto-complete** — conversations idle from 1 hour to 30 days (default 14 days) move to Done automati

cally. Manual Waiting keeps one open; choose Auto to return to the rule.
- **Stats page** — per-conv
ersation work time, wall-clock span, turns and token usage (input / cache read / cache write / outpu
t). A hand-drawn SVG chart set (no chart library, no external request) adds a stacked daily token tr
end, a daily work-time line, a 7×24 activity heatmap, a token donut, a conversation timeline and KPI
sparklines. A **money dimension** prices cache-hit input, cache-miss input, cache-write and output
separately, splits peak from off-peak hours (Beijing time, Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 are p
eak; nights, weekends and statutory holidays are half price for DeepSeek models), and ships an edita
ble price table. Work time and tokens are folded from the durable log by the Host half and served ov
er `GET /task-deck/stats` (loopback only, numbers only).

## How the data works
| Layer | Source |
| Session identity, title, workspace, running/idle, recent activity, fork parent | `ctx.sessions.lis

t` |
| Status override, Next Action, checklist, priority, branch label, alias | Personal annotations

in `localStorage` (`dsh.taskDeck.annotations.v1`) |
| Continue | `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession(sessi

onId)` |
| Fork / Handoff | `ctx.sessions.fork({ sessionId, increaseTitle: true })` |
Task Deck never copies transcripts. `Active` is a live runtime fact: a session is Active while its a
gent is running, and returns to Waiting (or your manual Blocked / Review / Done) when it stops.
`Done` can be manual or automatic. Auto-done is derived from the last activity timestamp: a non-runn
ing session with no manual status becomes Done after the configured idle window. Set Waiting manuall
y to keep it open, or choose Auto in the status field to return to the automatic rule.
## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.5`
- Web/Desktop Client with `sidebarRightTabs` and `sidebarRight`
## Development
The plugin is plain JavaScript and has no build step.

## Privacy

- Reads DSH session metadata (title, id, workspace, running state, fork relation).
- Stores only per

sonal annotations in browser `localStorage`.
- No transcript upload, no analytics, no external netwo

otations in browser `localStorage`.
- No transcript upload, no analytics, no external network calls.
